{{Top|leg}}
'''Hypernautics''' was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] specialization relating to the design, modification and repairing of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="SD">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Shintel Downtime|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> The planet [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], particularly its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Calamar]] (a center of high-tech research and development), specialized in hypernautics and advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engines.<ref name="SLJ">''[[Episode I Adventures 1: Search for the Lost Jedi]]''</ref> [[Fia (engineer)|Fia]] was a qualified hypernautics engineer, having graduated from [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University's]] [[School of Starship Engineering]].<ref name="SD" />
